verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins explicitly documents that plugins 'use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose server-backed capabilities to ChatGPT and Codex,' with a plugin browser (/plugins), marketplace add command, and plugin-creator skill that 'adds MCP server wiring' — showing first-party, well-documented support for plugging in MCP servers and using their tools. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of third-party MCP servers being installed and invoked successfully in Codex, and more detail on runtime tool-call behavior/limits.
